name: freelawgen-app
description: FreeLawGen React Native app — a thin client for regular people defending themselves in court. Points at YOUR OWN local LLM endpoint (Ollama / llama.cpp / LM Studio) and uses the @freelawgen/court deterministic Court procedure toolkit to draft, name, and count docket-ready pleadings. Runs entirely on your machine.
